blocks.text: show [TEXT] as QR code with error correction [LEVEL]
blocks.description: Shows the text as a QR code in place of this sprite's costume. The costume itself is not changed and comes back when the QR code is hidden or the project stops.

blocks.text: show [TEXT] as QR code with error correction [LEVEL] within [SIZE] stage units
blocks.description: Shows the text as a QR code no wider than SIZE stage units, with each module a whole number of units. Keep the sprite at 100% size and at odd x and y so the modules stay sharp; the code can come out smaller than SIZE.
Reports the side of the QR code this sprite is showing, in stage units at 100% size, or 0 when it shows none.
Puts this sprite's costume back in place of its QR code.
Reports whether this sprite is showing a QR code. Switching costume takes the QR code off.
Reports why the last show block of this extension failed, such as text-too-long, or nothing when it succeeded.
